name: Nonprofit Event Platform
summary: Custom Django platform replacing a failing Wix site for a Northern Colorado nonprofit—account-based event registration, atomic spot reservation to prevent overbooking, versioned waiver capture, volunteer-friendly admin tools with CSV roster export, and Stripe Checkout donations.

name: Pantry To Store
summary: Food waste reduction platform for a specialty food retailer—migrated off a restrictive platform to a custom headless-commerce storefront, eliminating platform fees and improving organic traffic.

name: Andrews Accounting
summary: Designed and shipped a custom site for a solo accounting practice, powered by a custom headless CMS with client-editable content and near-zero ongoing hosting costs.
